title: Jammu And Kashmir Administration Of Property Rules 1961

sections.shortTitle: Jammu And Kashmir Administration Of Property Rules 1961
sections.description:
JAMMU AND KASHMIR (ADMINISTRATION OF PROPERTY) RULES, 1961
JAMMU AND KASHMIR
(ADMINISTRATION OF PROPERTY) RULES, 1961
(Amendment of R.10)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 12th February, 2007]
S.R.O.10(KE)/2007,
dated 17-1-2007.---In exercise of
the powers conferred by section 6 of the Jammu and Kashmir (Administration of
Property) Ordinance, 1961 (III of 1961), the Federal Government is pleased to
direct that the following further amendments shall be made in the Jammu and
Kashmir (Administration of Property) Rules, 1961, namely:--
In the aforesaid
Rules, in rule 10,--
(a) for sub-rule
(1), the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(1) The sums
received as rent, lease or other dues of the property shall be deposited in a
separate account in any scheduled bank and shall be operated by the Administrator
or any other authorized by the Federal Government,"; and
(b) in sub-rule
(2), for the words "said Account" the words, brackets and figure
"account as provided in sub-rule (1) shall be substituted.
